Pointed-toe leather loafers, low flat heel, dark espresso (#3B2A20), polished leather

The blazer adds structure and covers the open shoulders, so the look stays office-appropriate and neat, while the satin keeps it elegant. Loafers and the structured tote keep the whole outfit polished and practical for a workday.
